newsitem.title: USA: IBM price target raised by Morgan Stanley.
newsitem.headline: IBM price target raised by Morgan Stanley.

text.p: Morgan Stanley analyst Steve Milunovich said he raised his 12-month price target on International Business Machines Corp to $170 from $145 previously.
IBM shares, which were off earlier, jumped 4-1/8 to 149-1/8 in heavy midafternoon exchange trading.
Milunovich said this new price target is about 13 times his current 1997 earnings estimates of $12.75 for IBM.

On last Friday, Merrill Lynch analyst Dan Mandresh said he had raised his price target on International Business Machines Corp shares to about $195 over the next 12 months igniting a major spurt in the Dow Jones Industrial Average. IBM shares soared over 8 to a high it has not seen since 1987.
